question_evidence_quote: Happy has to take 40% more cups of water than she takes now. If she is currently drinking 15 cups of water every week
violated_condition: The additional weekly intake must equal 40% of 15 cups, so 15 * 0.40 = 6.
error_description: The response correctly represents the recommended weekly intake as (15 * 0.40) + 15, but then replaces the product with 30. Multiplying 15 cups by 0.40 gives 6 cups, so the written arithmetic incorrectly computes the required increase.
